summary: Architecture and design only, zero implementation added. Designs Advisory Repository Skills as model-backed, evidence-only Repository Skills. Freezes the core principle (Advisory models may produce evidence, PCAE decides); the advisory pipeline (Repository State -> Prompt Builder -> Current Model -> Raw Response -> Normalizer -> Evidence Builder -> EvidenceCollection -> Decision Evaluation -> Repository Transition Validator); the model boundary (a model never returns a trusted PCAE object directly, the Normalizer is the sole conversion point, no tool-call authority, no file-write access); the default same-model mode (the current acting model may be the advisory model by default, no new configuration file/CLI flag/environment variable/model registry entry required); a documented-only future split-model mode (writer model vs. advisory model, named as a rationale only, not implemented); seven safety rules (probabilistic by default, model-produced, never sole authority for Accept, may trigger human review, may suggest repair, must include limitations, must cite references where possible -- all reusing existing Evidence/RepositorySkillManifest/InvariantResult fields, no schema change); failure behavior (UNKNOWN evidence or explicit advisory failure via the existing RepositorySkillResult two-outcome contract, never blocks deterministic checks by itself, never silently succeeds); and a narrow first future pilot scope (repository/documentation/report consistency review only, excluding code execution and lifecycle/commit/push/finalize authority). No Advisory Repository Skill implemented, no model call implemented, no DeepSeek/GLM/Claude/Codex/Qwen/OpenAI/local-SLM/any-backend integration, no model configuration added, no Repository Skills runtime, Evidence Provider, Decision Evaluation, Repository Transition Validator, or lifecycle command modified. Execution capability remains unavailable.
